text: {"lessons":["I added shares in all five stocks across several months, so I should check that each position still fits my plan instead of buying every stock by habit.","Selling some of A, C and E after sizable gains reduced my exposure to them; I should decide in advance how much to sell or rebalance rather than rely only on a gain percentage.","My account fell 4.3% after a run of gains, reminding me to keep a diversified portfolio and judge decisions over a longer horizon, not by the latest month."]}
